gen-silkscreen-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px opens its rounded letters wide, with large counters giving it a bookish, dignified footing. But Silkscreen is at its best as spaced-out, lo-fi lettering, while Slabo 13px is best at steady reading.
gen-special-elite-gf-hepta-slab: Scuffed, alternative, loud: Special Elite fills the line with a big x-height and a wide-mouthed a. Hepta Slab then stretches each word out with open, breathing counters and uniform strokes, so reading runs smooth and dignified.
gen-special-elite-gf-padyakke-expanded-o: Padyakke Expanded One spreads its glyphs like knots on a slack rope, each c a wide-mouthed pitcher. Padyakke Expanded One reads in a literary, authoritative voice, a steadier follow-on to Special Elite's scuffed lettering.
gen-special-elite-gf-stint-ultra-expande: A lowercase that fills the whole line defines Special Elite, with a wide-mouthed a. Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart like a pipe-cleaner, open counters leading outward, so reading feels spacious and authoritative.
gen-tourney-gf-kiwi-maru: Chunky, stretched-out, athletic: Tourney cuts uniform strokes and tracks its words wide, with bulky small letters. Kiwi Maru reads editorial and traditional, its generous letterspacing easing the eye along.
gen-tourney-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Tourney cuts every stroke to a single, uniform width. Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart like a pipe-cleaner, open counters leading outward, so reading feels spacious and authoritative.
gen-unifrakturmaguntia-fs-karma: UnifrakturMaguntia packs its words close and lofty, all gothic command, with a tall lowercase body. Karma follows with trustworthy, gently modulated strokes and clear terminals, so reading never snags the eye.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads literary and dignified, its tall middle band keeping ascenders and descenders shallow. Then Vast Shadow's vintage, uniform strokes catch the eye first, leaving Fauna One to read quietly.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-glegoo: Glegoo opens its curved letters with wide, unclosed mouths. Vast Shadow lends vintage, eye-catching strokes up top, and Glegoo's big counters and tall lowercase carry the text in refined, editorial fashion.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads traditional and refined, its counters spilling into open space. Stubby ascenders and descenders beside a big x-height make the text steady to read, while Vast Shadow handles the eye-catching vintage work.
